3190.title: Cross-tab root composer project reset
3190.rootCauseOneLine: A cross-tab storage subscription feeds a remote project ID into a stale sidebar cache, whose normalization effect persists the personal-project fallback back to every tab.
3190.proposedFix: Use the existing tab-scoped storage adapter for the root composer project atom so reload persistence remains but live storage events from other tabs are ignored.
3190.caveats: The deterministic component reproduction verifies the clobbering write but does not measure browser paint timing or exercise a live server.
